hints.title: Fix one value
hints.body: After sorting, choose one value and find two others that complete the sum.

hints.title: Two pointers
hints.body: For a fixed first value, move a left pointer and a right pointer inward based on the current sum.

hints.title: Skip duplicates
hints.body: Advance past repeated first values, and past repeated pointer values after recording a triplet.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sort nums
for i from 0 to n-3:
    if i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i-1]: continue
    left = i + 1, right = n - 1
    while left < right:
        total = nums[i] + nums[left] + nums[right]
        if total < 0: left += 1
        else if total > 0: right -= 1
        else:
            record triplet
            move both pointers and skip duplicates
return recorded triplets
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
